questions.question: What does Asaph ask God not to do in Psalm 83?
options: Hide his face while the wicked prosper in the land
Keep silence while enemies conspire against his people
Delay his coming while the righteous wait in hope
Withhold the rain while the harvest withers away
questions.answer: Keep silence while enemies conspire against his people

questions.question: What is the ultimate goal of the psalm's prayer against enemies?
options: That the king may reign on in lasting peace for very many years
That the holy temple may at long last be rebuilt in all its former glory
That they may know that the LORD alone is Most High over all the earth
That Israel may dwell safely and securely within the promised land
questions.answer: That they may know that the LORD alone is Most High over all the earth

questions.question: The enemies plot to wipe out the nation of Israel so its name is remembered no more.
O God, be not _____; do not hold your peace.
Let them know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most _____ over all the earth.
